children: DevvStream announced its special meeting of shareholders has been postponed to Sept. 17, 2026.
DevvStream's special meeting, originally set for Sept. 10, 2026, is rescheduled to Sept. 17, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET to allow more preparation time.
The meeting will remain virtual and previously submitted proxies remain valid unless revoked.
Rescheduling relates to the proposed business combination among XCF Global, DevvStream and Southern Energy under the April 13, 2026 agreement.
Definitive joint proxy statement/prospectus was mailed to shareholders; investors are urged to read filings and vote promptly.

title: DevvStream postpones shareholder meeting to Sept. 17 ahead of proposed XCF Global deal
